pitches: "If it explodes, it's a feature. I DESIGNED the feature."
"Four hundred terawatts of don't-touch-it, and I let YOU hold it. You're welcome."
"Recall? A recall is just a feature rollout in reverse. I don't do reverse."
"I'll explain slower: boom go big. Bigger boom go bigger. This is graduate-level stuff."
"Every one of these is hand-calibrated by me, so blame is also hand-calibrated. At you."
"Safety margin? I AM the safety margin."
deny: "No bolts, no boom-boom. Genius runs on revenue, friend."
"Come back when your wallet respects my engineering."
"I priced this in 'fair' and you brought 'hopeful'. Adorable."
buy: "KA-CHING! You now own the finest hardware in six systems. Do NOT read the sticker."
"Sold! No refunds — refunds imply error, and I don't manufacture those."
"Excellent choice. Statistically, MY statistics. It won't explode in the holster. Probably."
gratefulPitches: "My rescuer! Everything's 0% off, but I'll THINK about you fondly at full price."
"You busted me out with percussive force. As an engineer? Respect."
"That cell's welds were AMATEUR work. I was nearly free via spoon anyway. Still. Thanks."
tips: "A tip! For me? I mean — obviously. For me."
"Another bolt for the genius fund. The fund is a jar. The jar is the fund."
"Keep tipping and I'll name a warhead after you."
"You know what? You're my favorite customer. Legally non-binding."
